rows.note: For an established organization, especially an educational, public-service, or charitable one, this is the all-purpose choice.

example.english: This charitable institution has been helping low-income families for years.
example.traditional: 呢間慈善機構多年嚟一直幫助基層家庭。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 ci4 sin6 gei1 kau3 do1 nin4 lai4 jat1 zik6 bong1 zo6 gei1 cang4 gaa1 ting4

rows.note: Use this when institution means the premises or a residential or care facility where people are housed, rather than the organization itself.

example.english: The institution has decent facilities, and the residents receive care every day.
example.traditional: 嗰間院舍環境唔錯，住客每日都有專人照顧。
example.jyutping: go2 gaan1 jyun2 se3 waan4 ging2 m4 co3 zyu6 haak3 mui5 jat6 dou1 jau5 zyun1 jan4 ziu3 gu3

rows.note: Use this for institution as a socially established system or practice, as in marriage.

example.english: Marriage is an important institution in society.
example.traditional: 婚姻係社會上一項重要制度。
example.jyutping: fan1 jan1 hai6 se5 wui2 soeng6 jat1 hong6 zung6 jiu3 zai3 dou6
